|gprice = {{Price|500}} |value = {{Price|50}} |stats = {{Name|Defense|+1}} }} '''Sneakers''' are a [[footwear]] item in Stardew Valley. They can be purchased from and sold at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after completing the [[Quests#Initiation|"Initiation"]] quest. They can also be found as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special item]] in floors 1-39 of [[The Mines]] by killing [[The Mines#Special Items|special monsters]] or by breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], or in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Footwear]] [[de:Sneakers]] [[es:Deportivas]] [[fr:Baskets]] [[it:Scarpe da tennis]] [[ja:スニーカー]] [[ko:운동화]] [[hu:Edzőcipők]] [[pt:Tênis]] [[ru:Кроссовки]] [[tr:Spor Ayakkabıları]] [[zh:运动鞋]]
